description: This file defines handlers and functions for building and responding with a tools catalog in a gateway API, including resolving agent IDs, building core and plugin tool groups, and handling the 'tools.catalog' request.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdOrRespondError
methods.description: Resolves the agent ID from raw input or responds with an error if invalid.

methods.name: buildCoreGroups
methods.description: Builds core tool groups from core tool sections.

methods.name: buildPluginGroups
methods.description: Builds plugin tool groups based on plugin tools and metadata.

methods.name: buildToolsCatalogResult
methods.description: Constructs the tools catalog result object including agent ID, profiles, and groups.
